verdict.rationale: Snyk ships multiple AI-generated insight/suggestion features grounded in the product's own scan data: DeepCode AI-powered autofixes and risk scoring, an LLM-driven Remediation Agent that generates and applies fix plans enriched with Snyk security intelligence, and agentic CLI/IDE commands (/snyk-fix, snyk fix --agentic) that surface AI suggestions in-workflow. Independent probes confirm the CLI and MCP server actually exist and run, but community feedback (comm-6, comm-9, comm-10) raises accuracy/noise concerns about Snyk's suggestions, which tempers confidence without concretely disproving the AI-insight capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the AI-generated suggestions' quality/accuracy and more detail on how 'my data' specifically drives the insights.
